title: Get started with zupmxode
text: model written rxode2’s syntax read R’s parser, existing rxode2 models run unchanged. compiled native code milliseconds, without compiler.
code: m <- pmx_ode_model({   ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka); cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl); v <- exp(tv + eta.v)   d/dt(depot)   <- -ka * depot   d/dt(central) <-  ka * depot - cl / v * central   cp <- central / v }) pmx_ode_info(m)

title: Get started with zupmxode
text: pmx_ode_solve() deterministic core: parameters , predictions , random draws.
code: out <- pmx_ode_solve(m, ev, params = c(tka = 0.5, tcl = 1, tv = 3,                                         eta.ka = 0, eta.cl = 0,                                         eta.v = 0))

title: Get started with zupmxode
text: -subject variability residual error drawn R R’s random number generator, C engine stays deterministic. seed gives result thread count.
code: pmx_ode_threads(8) set.seed(1) sim <- pmx_ode_sim(m, ev, theta = c(tka = 0.5, tcl = 1, tv = 3),                     omega = diag(c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)),                     sigma = list(cp = prop(0.1)), n = 1000)
